card.name: Start of book, sheet, chap words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that begins with book, sheet, chap or read, such as bookkeeper, booklets, bookshelves, Booker, chaparral or readminister. It also fires on Book or sheet as a standalone noun in general web text.

modes.label: Book- compounds
modes.description: The start of words built on book, such as bookkeeper, booklets, bookshelves or Booker.

modes.label: Sheet of something
modes.description: The noun sheet before "of", meaning a thin layer or flat piece.
modes.example: could be mistaken for a simple<< sheet>> of black paper.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Other words cut after a short first piece, such as chap-arral or read-minister.
modes.example: cutting the limbs of the<< chap>>arral right and left.

card.writes: It favors odd word endings like "sis", "shelf" and "agem" and suppresses other endings, so it mainly shapes how the word continues.
card.plain: It marks the opening piece of a longer word like bookkeeper or bookshelves, or the word sheet, where the rest of the word comes next.
